name: Hemkund Sahib Gurudwara Langar
dress_code: head covered, shoes off, no leather
why_it_matters: The world's highest community kitchen — at 4633m, run by the Hemkund Sahib Gurudwara trust. Free khichdi, dal, and hot sweet tea served to every pilgrim who completes the 6km climb from Ghangaria. The hot tea after the final ascent is the most quietly engineered cup of chai in the Himalayas — it stops mild altitude shivers in their tracks.
insider_tip: Eat before the descent, not after arrival — the langar opens early and the hot khichdi at altitude does more for your stamina than any energy bar. Sip the tea slowly; gulping at 4600m can trigger nausea.
signature_address: Gurudwara Shri Hemkund Sahib, Hemkund Lake, Chamoli District, Uttarakhand 246443

name: Hotel Pritam Restaurant
why_it_matters: The most reliable sit-down meal in Ghangaria — a hotel-restaurant directly opposite the GMVN guest house, on the main path between the helipad and the gurudwara. Carries pure-veg multi-cuisine (north Indian, south Indian, Garhwali, basic Chinese) for the en-route stop where every Hemkund pilgrim sleeps before the final 6km push.
insider_tip: Order dal-rice or thali at lunch (cooked in volume, freshest); avoid the Chinese after 7pm when the kitchen winds down. Pakoras with chai at 4pm — the standard Ghangaria ritual after returning from the Valley of Flowers.
signature_address: Main path opposite GMVN Guest House, Ghangaria, Chamoli District, Uttarakhand 246443

name: Govindghat Gurudwara Langar
dress_code: head covered, shoes off, no leather
why_it_matters: The road-head gurudwara at the Alaknanda-Lakshman Ganga confluence — first hot meal for pilgrims arriving from Joshimath/Rishikesh, last meal before the 13km Ghangaria climb. Free langar runs through yatra season (May–Oct) with rajma chawal, dal-roti, and the same selfless-service ethic as Hemkund. Free dorm beds attached.
insider_tip: Arrive the night before your trek and sleep in the gurudwara dorm — saves a hotel night and gets you onto the trail by 5am, which is the difference between making Hemkund-and-back in one day or splitting into two.
signature_address: Gurudwara Govindghat, Badrinath Highway, Govindghat, Chamoli District, Uttarakhand 246443
